newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka bourse closed for silver jubilee of victory.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka bourse closed for silver jubilee of victory.

text.p: Bangladesh's main Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) and Chittagong Stock Exchange were closed on Monday because of a two-day public holiday marking the silver jubilee celebration of the country's independence.
The DSE all-share price index closed 14.15 points up at 2,670.8 on the last trading day on Saturday. Friday is weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
The market will reopen on Tuesday.
